summary: Scammers impersonated law enforcement and later Ledger support staff in a coordinated attempt to convince the victim that personal information and crypto assets were compromised. The operation sought to create urgency and obtain wallet recovery credentials through fabricated authority and security claims.
user_mistake: Engaged with unsolicited callers claiming to represent authorities and wallet providers
prevention: Terminate unsolicited security related calls and independently verify claims through official channels / Never disclose recovery phrases to anyone
